editorial:
Imagine waking up and realizing your brain just isn't working right. You have huge gaps in your memory, and you're not even sure who you can trust. That is exactly what you get with this wild ride. You follow Jack, a guy who is trying to piece together his life while hunting down the people who hurt him. The vibe is a weird but fun mix of a dark comedy and a tense thriller. It feels like you are solving a puzzle right along with him, and the way the story jumps around keeps you on your toes without getting too confusing. 

The acting is solid and makes the character's frustration feel real. You will love the unexpected twists that flip the script just when you think you have it figured out. While the pacing slows down a bit in the middle, the payoff at the end makes it worth it. If you are into mysteries that mess with your head, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you really love the plot, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep it.
endingExplained: You find out that Jack's memory loss was not just a random accident. The big twist reveals that he was manipulated by people he thought were helping him. In the final scenes, Jack finally connects the dots and realizes the truth about the betrayal. He manages to get his revenge on the villains, closing the loop on his trauma. It ends with him finding some peace, though he is forever changed by the secrets he uncovered.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves puzzles and unpredictable plot twists.
